text:
maya: quick heads-up. onboarding nebula-14b-xt (hf/nebulon-14b-xt) with q8_0 tiled_attention on runtime-3. smoke shows attention collapse / repeated phrases after resuming long prefixes. reproducible locally.

maya: repro command (trimmed):
```
python evals/onboard_smoke.py --model hf/nebulon-14b-xt --quant q8_0 --kernel tiled_attention --prefix "In 2049 the city" --max-tokens 300
```

maya: output tail: "... the city fell into silence the city fell into silence the city fell into silence"

luca: :eyes: does this happen on fp16/fp32 paths or only q8? is tiled kernel new for this family?

maya: only q8 path. fp16 path on same HW looks fine. tiled kernel was enabled by default in runtime-3 for larger heads after PR#3241.

sam: that PR bumped block tiling to 128 for perf. possible pointer arithmetic or eviction offset mismatch when combined with pack_stride change. can you dump KV pointer traces and attention bias sums?

nate: ran a quick probe on dev node, pasted small outputs below.
```
# kv pointers at resume points
kv_ptrs: [0, 128, 256, 384, 512, 640, 768, 896, 1024, 1152]
# attention_bias row sums (sample window)
row_sum_idxs: [0,1,2,3,...] -> [1.0, 0.98, 0.99, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.99, 0.98, 1.0, ...]
```

luca: those periodic drops look like whole rows reading zeros or wrapped memory. suspect pack_stride * block_size arithmetic overflow / wrap when computing GPU store offsets. q8 packing changes layout vs fp16.

maya: i also noticed tiled kernel uses pack_stride=128 in q8 loader while fp16 uses 64. shapes from model metadata: pack_stride meta=128, block_size=128.

sam: if runtime assumes pack_stride 64 in some code-paths but loader writes 128 layout -> address aliasing and repeated attention rows. ok filing INF-9901. priority: P1 for onboarding. linking PR to revert block_size change + fix pointer math. perf note: revert may cost ~4% on A100.

nate: quick mitigations we can add: 1) load-time sanity assert that computed kv_stride == expected 2) fallback to non-tiled kernel for quant path until patch lands 3) unit test that resumes KV across random split points.

maya: agreed. i'll run full eval after the revert/patch lands. posting small probe command for others to run:
```
python -c "from runtime.probe import probe_kv, probe_attention; print(probe_kv('hf/nebulon-14b-xt', quant='q8_0', kernel='tiled_attention'))"
```

luca: i'll prepare a tiny PR to add the kv-stride assert and a warning when pack_stride != expected. will add a quick regression test in onboarding harness.

ops-bot: onboarding job queued: build/1792109950 -> smoke tests pending

maya: thanks all. leaving notes in the onboarding doc and INF-9901. cc @sam for prioritization if Dedicated customers need immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
